indochina_ai.title: Thailand's first AI expo is on through 8 Nov at IMPACT Challenger Hall 1, Muang Thong Thani (Nonthaburi), with about 100 businesses and universities; iApp Technology is showing a Thai-language conversational model that processes data in-country, plus a rubber-harvesting robot and AI movie tools

FPT took three honours at AI Awards 2026 during AI4VN (5 Nov, VNU Hanoi, theme Agentic AI & The Future of Learning): FPT AI Factory in the Top 3 Outstanding AI Solutions, Kyta Platform in the Top 3 Outstanding AI Products, and Le Trung Hieu in the Top 5 Vietnamese AI Talents. Kyta uses AI agents as Digital Workers and serves more than 5,500 organisations and 7 million users

Cambodia's embassy in South Korea signed a tripartite MoU on 4 Nov with Eumseong County and the Korea Fire Industry Technology Institute for a free AI-based multilingual fire-safety platform (Korean, Khmer, English, Vietnamese, Chinese, Nepali), with Khmer launching first, to cut language-barrier risk for Cambodian workers

Myanmar's Union Minister for Science and Technology visited the University of Information Technology in Yangon and met students on the Professional Diploma in Artificial Intelligence and practical AI and cybersecurity courses (flag: government education visit)
